entities.name: Derelor
entities.description: Big centaur-like thrull with a giant frog head, summoned at least twice with widespread devastation.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Summoned a derelor in Sarpadia against the Farrelites.

entities.name: Farrelites
entities.description: Target of the derelor; their camp was annihilated.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed the derelor and annihilated the Farrelite camp, enraged by his sister's death.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Sister of Tevesh Szat, whose death enraged him.

entities.name: Endrek Sahr
entities.description: Thrull breeder given an execution order after the derelor failed.

entities.name: Kirsch
entities.description: Black mage who summoned the derelor in Mercadia City.

entities.name: Raitrick
entities.description: Sorcerer fused with the derelor to create the Delraich.

entities.name: Delraich
entities.description: Warped amalgam of thrull and sorcerer that murdered Sleedge and his men.

entities.name: Sleedge
entities.description: Caravan leader murdered by the delraich.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Where the first derelor was summoned.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: Where the second derelor was summoned.

events.summary: The Order of the Ebon Hand's derelor was killed immediately by Tevesh Szat's Fireball.
events.quote: was immediately killed by a Fireball cast by the planeswalker Tevesh Szat

events.summary: Szat annihilated the entire Farrelite camp, killing Oliver Farrel, Vaylesh and Sianna.
events.quote: Szat went on to annihilate the entire camp

events.summary: Kirsch's derelor was fused with the sorcerer Raitrick, creating the Delraich.
events.quote: Kirsch cast the spell using his vomit and Raitrick's blood

events.summary: The delraich murdered caravan leader Sleedge and all his men.
events.quote: murdering him and all his men and leaving his camp in tatters

relations.note: Killed the Sarpadian derelor with Fireball.
relations.quote: was immediately killed by a Fireball cast by the planeswalker Tevesh Szat
